meta_data.base_class: Calculate the <thermodynamic property> of air at constant pressure — these properties depend strictly on temperature, volume, and gas type, and are physically independent and mutually non-derivable.

tool_template.name: calc_<class>
tool_template.description: Calculate the <class> of a specific gas at constant pressure using its temperature and volume.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3.

gas.description: Type of gas for the <class> calculation, e.g., 'air'.

substance_purity.description: The purity of the gas as a percentage (0-100), affecting the <class> calculations.

measurement_accuracy.description: The required accuracy for the <class> calculation, e.g., 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.

reference_state.description: The reference state for the <class> calculation, such as 'standard' or 'ambient'.

units.description: The units in which the <class> result should be expressed.
